_comment: The fourteen blocking gates TRD Section 9 / TSD define. D0038: all fourteen are enumerated here. `wired` gates run in .github/workflows/ci.yml and block. `pending` gates have no runnable command yet and MUST name an open story - scripts/check-ci-gates.mjs fails if one does not, or if a wired gate is missing from the workflow. A fourteen-gate contract must not read as a seven-gate one, and a listed-but-unenforced gate must never read as passing.

gates.gate: Typecheck; no `any` in a public signature
Lint; token-tier and literal rules in component CSS
axe: zero serious or critical violations
Keyboard interaction suite, incl. focus-identity assertions
Token contrast, both themes, row count matched
Computed geometry: heights, target size, type floors

gates.run: pnpm check:publint && pnpm check:attw && pnpm check

gates.gate: Consumer verification: Vite + Next.js builds, no hydration warnings
Server/client boundary: every exported component is classified

plus.gate: A changeset is present on any packages/ change
pnpm audit clean of high/critical CVEs
